Definition: properly, an acclaim, i.e. a choir of singers
BiblicalUsage: huyᵉdâh is the word for an acclaim, a choir of singers. It appears in Nehemiah, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: This word, huyᵉdâh, does its job quietly — an acclaim, a choir of singers — and I leave it at that.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
